Renumber or restore the log so no premise references a nonexistent ID, and add one sentence to the §16 preamble stating that every P# premise maps to an existing row ID (auditable in one pass). This converts P4 and P8 from assertions into measured premises and discharges the r3 'replace shorthand premise logs' scope item.

result.strongest_objection: The protocol's two load-bearing execution prerequisites are admitted-UNKNOWN rather than verified, and the author concedes the searches that would settle them were never run on the roots that would answer them. PR (§5) mandates an ALREADY-EXISTING facility that enforces GET-only method/path policy 'independently of credentials and server authorization' and forbids building one (D6, §13 non-goals); E3 requires a positively DECLARED capture corpus. Yet V4 states 'the agent-runtime/fleet roots that would own one were NOT searched (declared missing roots)' and V10 states the method-filter search 'is NOT exhaustive absence proof. Existing external enforcement availability is UNKNOWN.' Under premise-verification, the decisive feasibility premises (does a confinement facility exist? does a capture cohort exist?) are therefore unverified exactly where the doc's own completion gate (§8/AC9: ≥3 qualifying successes, each requiring PR-passed plus a live walk) depends on them. As written, every attempt is structurally terminal at NOT-RUN(ISOLATION) or NOT-RUN(NO-CORPUS), so the row cannot reach its own acceptance criteria — the doc itself half-concedes this ('park explicitly'), which means it is requesting a fresh full author-excluding quorum for a protocol it predicts cannot execute. That is a design-doc defect, not an audit finding: quorum effort should not be spent until the UNKNOWN is resolved into either a positively identified facility/cohort (pinned in §PR/E3) or an explicit PARKED status.
result.catch: Two things to fix before resubmission. (1) Close the declared verification gap: the r3 author must either obtain from the controller the concrete agent-runtime/fleet root list and run + quote the recorder/confinement searches there (the absence claims in P7/V4/V10 are currently scoped to this repo only and are asserted absent), or secure a controller-cited positive identification naming the facility (identity/version/configuration) and the corpus cohort (path, sha256, producer, completeness) — recorded as new §16 rows, not left as 'declared missing roots'. (2) The §16 evidence is not in the doc: it says 'Exact commands, exit statuses and raw quoted outputs are in [designer premise transcript](../verification/world-iter222/designer.md)', which is outside the reviewed document, so V1–V11 (HEAD sha, isProtected scope, merge-base rc1 at both tips) are claimed-verified but not verifiable from this artifact; the raw transcript must be moved under this row's own verification folder so the premise log is self-contained for the quorum it demands.
result.proposed_fix: (1) Add to §16 and perform before quorum, with quoted raw outputs committed to `design_docs/verification/w-provenance-teeth-unseeded-baselined-walk/iter222-premise-transcript.md` (relocate the existing designer.md content there and repoint the link): new rows 'V12 — Controller-declared fleet/agent-runtime root enumeration: quote the root list; recursive grep for proxy|filter|sandbox|method-enforce|allowlist facilities; quoted hits or quoted zero-hit output plus positive control; conclusion: facility named with identity/version/config OR absence proven only within the enumerated roots.' and 'V13 — Same roots, search for mission→World recorder/capture wiring (producer, store path, event schema); quoted results; conclusion: cohort declared {path, sha256, producer, completeness} OR capture gap confirmed as the row's first finding.' (2) Replace the Status paragraph with a conditional: 'If V12 and V13 positively identify the facility and cohort, pin them here (facility identity + configuration in §PR; cohort declaration values in E3) and proceed to fresh full author-excluding quorum. If either is absent, status changes to PARKED (facility|corpus) awaiting controller disposition; no quorum requested, no NOT-RUN attempt consumed.' This converts V4/V10's admitted non-exhaustive UNKNOWNs into either load-bearing verified premises or an explicit, honest park — matching the doc's own 'If infeasible, park explicitly' line, which the current quorum-requesting status contradicts.
